name: devtools-standard-toolkit
description: Standard high-quality prompts and skills for software development with .NET and modern architectures.
author: AI DevTools Team

prompts.name: Comprehensive Code Review
prompts.description: Audits code for Clean Code, SOLID, OWASP security vulnerabilities, and performance.

prompts.name: Architecture Decision Record Generator
prompts.description: Guides the creation of structured ADRs based on architectural trade-offs.

prompts.name: C4 Architecture Model & Boundary Auditor
prompts.description: Analyzes project layers and verifies architectural boundaries and dependencies.

prompts.name: Unit Test & TDD Generator
prompts.description: Generates robust unit tests using xUnit, FluentAssertions, and Moq with full boundary coverage.

prompts.name: C# Idiomatic Modernizer
prompts.description: Modernizes legacy C# patterns to modern C# 12/13 idioms safely.

prompts.name: Project Architecture & Requirements Interview
prompts.description: Conducts interactive project discovery, asks key technical questions, and formulates the optimal blueprint.

prompts.name: Project Scaffolding & Directory Blueprint
prompts.description: Designs standardized folder structure, solution layouts, and setup files.

prompts.name: Frontend Minimalist Design Tokens Generator
prompts.description: Generates cohesive typography scales, slate palettes, and spacing tokens in CSS.

prompts.name: Frontend Design System & Component Architect
prompts.description: Synthesizes complete design tokens, CSS custom properties, component guidelines, and accessibility standards.

skills.name: Roslyn Workspace & Diagnostics Analyzer
skills.description: Inspects C# syntax trees, compiler warnings/errors, and semantic models.

skills.name: Git Diff & Workspace Inspector
skills.description: Extracts Git staged, unstaged diffs, branch status, and commit logs.

skills.name: DotNet Test Runner & Analyzer
skills.description: Runs automated tests and extracts structured pass/fail metrics and failure traces.

skills.name: Database Query & Index Optimizer
skills.description: Analyzes SQL queries, EF Core LINQ projections, missing indexes, and N+1 query patterns.

skills.name: EF Core Migration & Schema Drift Validator
skills.description: Verifies EF Core migrations for destructive changes and zero-downtime compatibility.

skills.name: OpenAPI & REST Contract Linter
skills.description: Validates REST API designs against RFC 7807 problem details and idempotent standards.

skills.name: gRPC & Protocol Buffers Compatibility Auditor
skills.description: Audits .proto files and gRPC services for backwards compatibility and field tag rules.

skills.name: Classic Minimalist UI & Design System Auditor
skills.description: Evaluates UI components against classic minimalist design, typographic scale, and slate palettes.

skills.name: WCAG 2.1 Accessibility & A11y Auditor
skills.description: Scans UI components and markup for WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA compliance and ARIA landmarks.

skills.name: Data Pipeline Contract & Schema Drift Validator
skills.description: Verifies data stream schemas (JSON Schema, Avro, Parquet) for breaking mutations and drift.

skills.name: Stream Processing & Idempotent Consumer Auditor
skills.description: Audits message consumers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus) for exactly-once processing and DLQs.

skills.name: Frontend Design System & Token Generator
skills.description: Generates cohesive tokens (palettes, typography, spacing) adhering to classic minimalist UI.

skills.name: Frontend Component Architecture & Hierarchy Designer
skills.description: Decomposes layouts into atomic components with prop contracts and state hoisting.

skills.name: Responsive Layout Engine & Fluid Grid Designer
skills.description: Calculates responsive breakpoints, fluid clamp() typography, CSS Grid split-pane structures, and container queries.
